method.unit: 504 distinct logical positions in the actual 28x18 map model plus one independently reproduced AI runtime failure. Two root causes, not 505 independent implementation defects.
method.originalDOM: The baseline editor was one unfocusable canvas, not 504 DOM controls. Position count comes from the exported production map, not invented records or arbitrary canvas pixels.
method.beforeEvidence: Native pointer sample changes a corner, native keyboard probe leaves the map unchanged, and the visible editor canvas cannot receive focus. The shared missing keyboard path applies to all 504 logical positions.
method.afterEvidence: Every logical position is actually traversed and painted with native keyboard input. The native export is compared with the expected full matrix after restoring unique start positions.
method.deduplication: Each coordinate counts once; viewports, tools, repeated input methods and AI levels are not additional findings. Support changes are excluded.
method.axe: These are custom keyboard/runtime findings. Zero after-fix axe violations are validation, not the source of the 505 count.

checks: 504 named native grid cells and one Tab entry
Mouse click and drag grouped into one undo
Touch tap and native touch panning without painting
Unique starts, export, save and reopen
At least 28px targets and contained document width
validation.source: Studio inline script, root 154 script blocks/files, catalog, 55-page skip navigation and 11 Node test files passed.
validation.network: Local production source only; external HTTP/WebSockets blocked and service workers disabled. Tests write only isolated local storage and temporary downloads.
validation.ci: New central job pins the exact PVP fix commit. New PR CI pending at report creation.

limits: Logical editing positions are distinct from DOM node counts and independent code defects.
AI samples cover 2.5 seconds at three levels, not all custom maps, tactics or long-running sessions.
Automated keyboard, rendering and axe checks do not replace real-device or screen-reader usability review.
